decision_boundary.description: Platinum Rose AI may propose plays, but a human must verify a proposal before it becomes an official tracked paper bet.

futures_portfolio.pre_cutoff_policy: The AI can propose futures before the cutoff, but it must account for preseason price movement, late-opening futures markets, and potential in-season futures entry points before asking for official tracking approval.
futures_portfolio.in_season_futures_policy: Futures can remain candidates after the cutoff when new price dislocations appear because of performance, injuries, roster changes, or market liquidity.

in_season_weekly.deadline_policy: Weekly official picks must be locked before the relevant market starts unless explicitly marked as a live/in-game paper play.

market_holds.rule: Exacta and Super Bowl matchup plays are monitor-only until a secondary BetOnline market appears for price shopping against BetUS or another placeable book.
